result: Built and structurally verified a fresh 8 GiB Pi 4B raw image from the current Pi desktop staging output. It has not been flashed to or booted from a physical microSD card.

zealos_data.contents: Full-size RedSea volume followed by two 32 MiB append-only source banks

checks: Pi desktop staging validation passed native/recovery ELF identity, load bounds and relocations, two-entry boot chain, and all 1049 source modules.
The image builder verified MBR extents, FAT32 boot files, required firmware and payload read-back, RedSea geometry/root/Home/Tmp/bitmap, and both source-bank headers.
make check-pi4-platform passed, including partition-bounded I/O with FAT isolation and fake SDHCI single-block write/flush/read-back.
known_scope: This is a host-built raw image, not the UTM ISO or a Pi USB installer.
Pi must explicitly run psdopen before persistent writes; this binding is not automatic.
Physical SD-controller behavior, writes, flush, cold-boot persistence, and current-image HDMI audio remain unverified.
Writes are bounded to the ZealOS data partition; the firmware FAT partition is outside the writable range.
